thought.text: `admin-cli` works. Now let me verify the Keycloak client configuration and roles.

reasoning_content: `admin-cli` works. With this, I can verify the client configuration and roles.

action.command:
ADMIN_TOKEN=$(curl -s -X POST "http://localhost:8080/realms/master/protocol/openid-connect/token" -d "grant_type=password&client_id=admin-cli&username=admin&password=admin" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['access_token'])") && UUID=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients?clientIds=strassennamen" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]['uuid'])") && echo "=== Client config ===" && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$UUID" | python3 -c "
import sys,json
c=json.load(sys.stdin)
for k in ['clientId','enabled','publicClient','standardFlowEnabled','implicitFlowEnabled','directAccessGrantsEnabled','serviceAccountsEnabled','rootUrl','baseUrl','adminUrl','redirectUris','webOrigins']:
    print(k+':', c.get(k))
print('postLogout:', c.get('attributes',{}).get('post.logout.redirect_uris'))
" && echo "=== Client roles ===" && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/clients/$UUID/roles" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print([r['name'] for r in json.load(sys.stdin)])" && echo "=== user1 role mappings ===" && UID2=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users?username=user1" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]['id'])") && curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" "http://localhost:8080/admin/realms/my-realm/users/$UID2/role-mappings/clients/$UUID" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print([r['name'] for r in json.load(sys.stdin)])"
